verses.text: Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ob'iltak heb' anima tzek' wal t'a yib'anh. Tzijtum tas sna heb' t'a yol yiko', max yal heb' wab'i. Komonnhej sb'o junok trato heb' sch'okoj, manhok in pax swak' sk'ulej heb'. Yuj chi' te niwan tz'aj smul heb' t'a yib'anh.
Elanhchamel sb'at heb' t'a Egipto, max sk'anb'ej heb' t'ayin. Snib'ej heb' skolji yuj yipal winh sreyal Egipto chi', syak'anoch heb' yipok sk'o'ol.
Palta a skolwal jun winh rey chi', k'ixwelal ol utajkan heb' yuj, ol somchajkank'e heb' yuj skolwal jun nación chi'.
Wach'chom ayb'at heb' schekab' heb' t'a chonhab' Zoán yet' t'a chonhab' Hanes,
k'ixwelal ol utaj heb' yuj Egipto chi'. Malaj jab'ok tas ol yik' heb' t'ay, manh ol kolwaj jab'ok t'a heb'. Anhej to ol k'ixwokkanel heb' yuj, xchi Jehová.

Ha tas ix yal Jehová yuj nok' nok' ay t'a yol yik Neguev: Ha t'a jun lugar chi' te ay smay. Hata' kajan nok' choj, jantak yok' nok' ta'. Ay nok' ajawchan yet' nok' chan sjenhwi. Hata' tzek' nok' chej yet' nok' camello skuchanb'at sb'eyumal chonhab' Judá yik syak'an silab'ok t'a Egipto, palta a jun nación chi' max kolwaj jab'ok.
Ha jun nación chi' max yal-laj yuj, max techaj skolwaji, yuj chi' swak' sb'iej icha tik: Nok' te ay smay yel yaw, palta malaj tas syal yuj, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ha tikne'ik tz'ib'ejkan masanil tas wan walan tik t'ayach t'a yichanh heb' etchonhab' tik, yik skan yab'ixal t'a heb' t'a junelnhej, yik sna'annhejkot heb'.
Ha heb' anima tik, te pit heb', yinhtilal esalwum heb'. Malaj snib'ej heb' syab' in cheknab'il a in Jehová in tik.
Syalan heb' t'a heb' in chekab' icha tik: Manh eyal t'ayonh tas ix ak'ji eyil chi'. Manh eyal lolonel yik tojolal. Ha sko k'ana' to anhej lolonel sko nib'ej skab'i, a tzeyala'.
Elanhek t'a yol ko b'e. Ha ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik Haxonhej Ochi, manhxo eyalkot t'ayonh, xchi heb', xchi Jehová.
Yuj chi', a in he Diosal in a ex israel ex tik to Ha inxonhej Ochi, swal icha tik: Ha ex tik ix he patikejel jun kachnab'il, haxo pitalil yet' chukal tzeyak'och yipok he k'o'ol.
Yuj chi' a eyahelal ol em t'a eyib'anh yuj he mul chi', lajan ol aj icha junok muro pojeltakxo, tz'eyanxoek'i. Yalxonhej janik' ol em lanhnajok.

Ol ex satjokel icha junok niwan xalu smak'jipojok, manhxa niwank'olal t'ay. Haxo stitak lum chi', manhxa jab'ok syal yoch lechlab'il, maxtzak yalpax yik'jib'at jab'ok tzak'ak' t'a kusinu yet'ok, xchi Jehová.

Ha Kajalil, haton Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik Haxonhej Ochi, a tz'alan icha tik: Meltzajanhek t'ayin. Hak'ek in och yipok he k'o'ol. Manh ex och ilk'olal. Icha chi' ol aj he kolchaji, xchi. Palta max he cha eyab'i.

Anhej to tzeyal icha tik: Ma'ay, a onh tik ol onh k'e t'a yib'anh chej, ol onh b'at elelal, xe chi. Yelton tzeyala', ol ex b'at elelal chi'. Tzeyalanpax icha tik: Ol onh k'e t'a yib'anh nok' chej jelan sb'eyi, xe chi. Palta yelxo ek'b'al jelan sb'ey heb' eyajk'ol chi' t'a eyichanh.

Anhej t'a jun pitanh heb' ajk'ol chi', jun mil ex ol ex el elelal. Wach'chom anhej owanhok heb' ajk'ol chi', ol ex el elelal he masanil t'a heb'. Jaywanhexxonhej ol ex kanok, icha skan linhan junok te te' t'a jolom witz, ma icha bandera t'a chon tzalan, xchi Jehová chi'.

Palta te niwan tz'ok' sk'ol Jehová t'ayex, tanhwab'il ex yuj. Tato wach' tzeyutej he b'a, ol ok' sk'ol t'ayex, ol ex yak'an niwank'olal, yujto tojol toni. Ha heb' tz'ak'anoch Jehová chi' yipok sk'o'ol, te wach' yik heb'.
Ex aj Sion, ex kajan ex t'a Jerusalén, manhxo ol ex ok'ok. Ha Jehová ol ok' sk'ol t'ayex ayik ol yab'an yel eyaw. Ayik ol eyalan he b'a t'ay, ol tak'wok t'ayex t'a elanhchamel.
Wach'chom tzex ek' t'a skal syahelal yuj Dios Kajal, palta he k'ayb'umal yaji. Manhxo ol sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'ayex, palta ol eyil yet' he sat.
Tato ol ex el t'a he b'e, tzex b'at t'a he wach', ma t'a he k'exanh, ol eyab' yalji jun lolonel t'a he patik icha tik: Manh ex b'at ta', ina sb'at b'e tik, b'atanhek t'ay, xchama.
Ol he patikejel juntzanh yechel nab'a plata yet' he komon Dios ayoch oro t'ay, ol eyumankanel icha k'alem yajb'entak yilji.
Ichato chi' b'i'an, ol yak'ankot nhab' Jehová chi' t'a yib'anh tas tzeyawej, te wach' ol ajok. Ha nok' he wakax t'a jun pekti' chi', toxonhej ol aktajkan nok' b'aj ol waok.
Ha nok' he wakax yet' nok' he b'uru smunlaji, wach' ixim cebada ol sk'ux nok'.
Ayik ol k'och sk'uhal yem lanhnaj yet'tal heb' eyajk'o'ol, ayik ol cham heb' smasanil, tzijtum ha' niwak ha' ol elta seknaj t'a jolomtak witz yet' t'a tzalkiltak.

Haxo yok k'e'en uj, icha yok k'u ol ajkanok. Haxo pax yok k'u chi', ukel ol aj yowal yok. Icha wal yok ukeok k'uhal ol aj jun k'uhal chi'. Ha wal ta' ol b'oxok sk'ol schonhab' Jehová yuj. Ichato ol spich yechen heb' lajwinak yuj.
Ileknab' skot Jehová t'a najat. Ha yowal sk'o'ol lajan icha te' k'ak' sk'e nhilnhon yok. Ayik sloloni, lajan icha te' k'ak' stz'ab'at tastak yuj.

Yuj slolonel chi' satel heb' ajk'o'ol, icha wal junok niwan eluma' tz'el t'a smelemal, sk'ek'och ha' t'a sjaj heb'. Ol ik'jokb'at heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay, icha yel smatz'il ixim trigo yuj ik' ayik schayaj ixim. Ichato ol ak'jokoch sfreno heb' anima chi', yik tz'ik'jib'at heb' b'aj ol satel yuj Jehová chi'.

Palta a exxo tik, ol ex b'itanok, icha tzex b'itan t'ak'walil ayik tz'och k'inh ayik tze na'ankot tas aj yelnakkot heb' he mam eyicham t'a Egipto. Tzalajk'olal eyiko', icha ayik tze pu'an he flauta ayik tzex k'e t'a stzalanil stemplo Jehová Skolumal Israel.
Ol yak' Jehová ab'chaj sjaj, cha'anh yel yaw, ol sch'oxanel spoder yet' yowal sk'o'ol, icha te' k'ak' satanel tastak yet' niwak ik' nhab' yet' sk'anh k'u yet' sakb'at.
Ayik ol yab'an sjaj Jehová heb' aj Asiria, ol te xiw heb', ichato ol mak'jok k'ichaj heb' yuj yet' sk'en k'okoch.
Ayik ol spajanoch juntakelok sk'okoch Jehová t'a heb' aj Asiria chi', ol och tanhb'il yet' arpa yuj heb' schonhab'. Te ay smay jun owal ol och t'a Asiria yuj Jehová chi'.

Yujto toxon b'ob'il jun yet'tal winh sreyal Asiria yet' heb' soldado yuj Jehová, b'aj ol tz'a sniwanil heb'. Ha jun yet'tal chi' te lewan sat, jul pax yich, b'ut'an yet' te' k'atzitz. Ha Jehová ol ak'anoch sk'ak'al yet' slolonel, ol k'e nhilnhon yok icha azufre.
